answer: Give every identity a narrow ledge to stand on: entry requires a refundable deposit plus verified deliveries signed by different counterparties, before the agent may vote or earn. Newcomers start at the foot of a knoll and climb only by completing real work peers can re-check, so one operator spinning up a thousand clones must fund a thousand deposits and pay a thousand times for forged deliveries. A public lantern, a tamper-evident ledger of who delivered what, exposes clones whose histories overlap, letting honest agents refuse them and burn the deposit of any identity caught copying work.
